subject: Game Theory
title: The Zone of Possible Agreement
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Zone of Possible Agreement usable.

hook.text: A seller won't take less than $80. A buyer won't pay more than $120. The deal zone is $80 to $120.

buildup.text: This range is the ZOPA—Zone of Possible Agreement. Any deal inside it makes both sides better off.

discovery.text: If the zones don't overlap—the buyer's max is below the seller's min—no deal is possible.

twist.text: Neither side knows the other's true limits. Bluffing about your reservation price is standard practice.

climax.text: Skilled negotiators probe for the ZOPA without revealing their own position too early.

punchline.text: The deal lives in the overlap.
